description: A required response field is removed from a public schema.

files.content:
components:
  schemas:
    Order:
      type: object
      required:
        - id
      properties:
        id:
          type: string

candidates.title: Required status field was removed from Order

evidence.execution_path: Existing clients deserialize Order responses and access the previously required status field
evidence.violated_invariant: A backward-compatible response evolution must preserve fields required by existing clients
evidence.requirement_source: fixture baseline contract requires id and status
evidence.falsifier_checked: No version bump, compatibility adapter, or replacement field is present in the changed contract

candidates.impact: Existing clients can fail or silently mis-handle order state.
candidates.recommendation: Restore the field or introduce a versioned migration path.

verdicts.reason: The baseline requirement and changed response schema demonstrate a breaking removal.
